lead: "5 minutes ago" for a moment, as a `<time>` element with the exact moment in its `dateTime` and, on hover, the full date. It follows the `locale` of ConfigProvider. `formatRelativeTime` gives the same text as a string.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: The largest unit that fits: seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, years; the left is the past, the right the future.

numeric.title: Yesterday or 1 day ago
numeric.description: `numeric="auto"` (the default) says "yesterday" and "now", `always` says "1 day ago".

refresh.title: Keeping it current
refresh.description: `refresh` counts again every this many seconds, so the text does not go stale on a page that stays open.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: RelativeTime renders a plain `<time>` with no slot: style it with the text around it.
